messages:
Nora (PM): Short thread: we must finalize GA defaults for trace sampling, cost bands, and console indicators. Customers want predictability.

Ike (ENG): Backend supports per-tenant sample_rate + error-preserve. Recommend default sample_rate=0.001 (0.1%), preserve_errors=0.10, adaptive uplift rules for sustained error spikes. Expose budget_usd and preset enum in API.

Sam (SRE): Ops asks for three preset bands: dev $10/day, team $60/day, enterprise manual. Hard cap default $120/day. On cap: switch to headers-only, reduce sample_rate x10, set tenant flag "telemetry.throttled" and send owner alert.

Priya (ML): For launch acceptance: run 48h canary across three tenants. Criteria: >=92% recall on prioritized error signatures at default sampling OR targeted retention enabled. Also anomaly detection F1 drop <=5%.

Nora (PM): Console UX: tenant card shows "budget used (USD)", "projected 24h spend", and badge: normal/uplifted/throttled. Add quick actions: "Pause hi-fi traces" and "Request increased retention" (enterprise only).

Ike (ENG): API sketch (string): sampling_policy={default_rate:0.001,error_preserve_pct:0.1,adaptive:[{when:'error_rate>1%',set:0.01,ttl:3600}]},budget_usd=60

Sam (SRE): Runbook: global kill-switch to force conservative sampling 0.0005 if >2 tenants throttle in 24h. Dashboard to list throttled tenants.

Nora (PM): Owners: Ike API/console, Sam throttle+runbook, Priya canary evals. Reconvene Friday 10am to sign off wording for customer docs.

ThrottleBot: Created ticket: infra/telemetry#2100 "per-tenant sampling + budget bands" assigned to @Ike.
